description: This file sets up testing infrastructure for strict export version 2 in PyTorch's Torch export module. It imports relevant test modules, defines a mocked version of the export function that enforces specific configuration, and dynamically creates test classes with mocking behavior. It concludes by invoking a test runner if executed as the main script.

methods.name: mocked_strict_export_v2(*args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Wraps the export function to enforce strict mode unless explicitly specified in kwargs, applying a specific configuration patch.

methods.description: Creates a mocked test class with strict export v2 behavior, adds it to globals, and modifies its module.
